description: This file implements an image search service with a fallback heuristic. It exports a function for searching products by image, either via backend API or mock heuristic, and includes internal functions for normalizing results, tokenizing text, scoring keywords, loading products, and performing heuristic matching.

methods.name: searchByImage
methods.description: Main exported function that searches for products matching an image, using backend API if available, otherwise falling back to heuristic matching.

methods.name: normalizeBackendResults
methods.description: Normalizes backend search results to a consistent format, resolving product IDs to product objects if necessary.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Converts text into an array of lowercase tokens, removing non-alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: keywordScore
methods.description: Calculates a score based on how many keywords are included in the given text.

methods.name: guessKeywordsFromFilename
methods.description: Extracts keywords from a filename by tokenizing it.

methods.name: loadAllProducts
methods.description: Loads all products from a service or mock data as a fallback.

methods.name: computeSimilarityScore
methods.description: Computes a simple similarity score between a product and a set of keywords based on name and description.

methods.name: mockHeuristicMatch
methods.description: Performs heuristic matching of a file against products based on filename and alt text keywords.
